info.name: Get information about all currently supported chains

params.name: chainTypes
params.description: Restrict the resulting chains to the given chainTypes. Available values: EVM, SVM, UTXO, MVM, TVM. Pass all values to get every supported chain. If this parameter is omitted, the API returns only EVM chains.

items.docs: If you want to learn more about how to use this endpoint please have a look at our [guide](/sdk/chains-tools).
